title: The Support Buddy X9000 — Agentic Support Engineering Platform
description: An agentic support engineering platform built around a Mission Control work queue. A 10-agent LangGraph pipeline investigates tickets in parallel, ranks root causes with evidence, and—with human approval—hands validated issues to Devin AI for autonomous bug reproduction, fix authoring, and session tracking.
highlights: 10-agent LangGraph investigation pipeline with parallel evidence gathering, RAG knowledge search, and root-cause ranking.
Devin AI integration for autonomous bug reproduction, code fixes, and defect authoring—tracked in a dedicated session dashboard.
Mission Control work queue with shift briefing, responsibility overview, approval queue, and priority ticket triage.

details.problemStatement: Support teams burn hours manually triaging tickets that follow the same patterns — this platform autonomously investigates, ranks root causes, and hands validated fixes to an AI coding agent, so engineers focus only on what needs human judgment.
details.extendedDescription:
The Support Buddy X9000 is a fully agentic support engineering platform built around a Mission Control dashboard — a prioritized work queue that gives support engineers a real-time view of active responsibilities, approval queues, and shift briefings.

When a ticket is escalated for investigation, a pipeline of 10 specialized AI agents runs in parallel: classifying the ticket, pulling customer context, analyzing logs, searching the knowledge base, correlating incidents and deployments, ranking root cause hypotheses, drafting responses, and running guardrails checks. Each agent's inputs, outputs, and reasoning are visible in the investigation view.

Once a root cause is confirmed and approved, the issue is handed off to Devin AI, which autonomously reproduces the bug, authors fixes, and tracks each session — total tasks, active reproductions, finished fixes, and failed attempts — in a dedicated Devin AI dashboard.

features.title: Mission Control Dashboard
features.description: A prioritized work queue showing active responsibilities, shift briefing, responsibility overview (Needs Action, In Progress, Waiting Customer, Pending Approvals), and a live priority ticket queue with urgency classification.

features.title: Live Investigation View
features.description: Watch the 10-agent pipeline run in real time — Ticket Classification, Customer Context, Log Analysis, and Knowledge Retrieval execute in parallel while Root Cause Hypotheses build with confidence scores and supporting evidence.

features.title: 10-Agent Pipeline
features.description: Each of the 10 specialized agents handles one aspect of the investigation: Ticket Classification → Customer Context → Log Analysis → Knowledge Retrieval → Incident Correlation → Deployment Correlation → Root Cause Analysis → Response Drafting → Guardrails Check → Escalation Note. The About Agents view documents every agent's inputs, outputs, and how it helps troubleshoot.

features.title: Devin AI Bug Reproduction
features.description: Validated issues are handed to Devin AI, which autonomously reproduces bugs and authors fixes. A dedicated dashboard tracks every session — total tasks, active reproductions, finished fixes, failed attempts, and average poll count — giving engineers full visibility without manual follow-up.

title: AI Support Engineer — AI-Powered Customer Support Copilot
description: An AI-powered support copilot that layers on top of a customer support CRM. Support agents can analyze tickets, surface similar resolved cases, generate multi-tone reply drafts, and ask free-form questions — all powered by OpenAI with async job execution and live status updates.
highlights: Ticket analysis extracts signals, hypotheses, and clarifying questions via GPT-4o-mini.
Vector search with pgvector (HNSW indexing) surfaces similar resolved cases in real time.
Multi-tone draft generation (Professional, Friendly, Concise, Surfer), RAG knowledge base pipeline, PII redaction, and full audit trail.

details.problemStatement: Support agents waste hours searching for similar resolved tickets and drafting replies from scratch — this copilot surfaces relevant cases instantly and generates ready-to-send drafts, without replacing the agent's judgment.
details.extendedDescription:
The AI Support Engineer is a copilot built to augment — not replace — customer support agents. It integrates directly with an existing CRM workflow, adding AI-powered analysis, similarity search, and draft generation without changing how agents interact with tickets.

When a new ticket arrives, the system uses GPT-4o-mini to extract key signals, form hypotheses about the root cause, and suggest clarifying questions. Simultaneously, pgvector-powered similarity search surfaces past resolved cases that match the current issue, giving agents instant context.

Agents can generate reply drafts in multiple tones — Professional, Friendly, Concise, or Surfer — and the system includes PII redaction, a RAG-powered knowledge base for internal documentation, and a complete audit trail of every AI action taken.

features.title: Intelligent Ticket Analysis
features.description: GPT-4o-mini extracts signals, hypotheses, and clarifying questions from ticket content, giving agents an instant head start on understanding the issue.

features.title: Vector Similarity Search
features.description: pgvector with HNSW indexing surfaces similar resolved cases in real time, so agents can reference past solutions without manual searching.

features.title: Multi-Tone Draft Generation
features.description: Generate reply drafts in four distinct tones — Professional, Friendly, Concise, and Surfer — tailored to the ticket context and customer relationship.

features.title: PII Redaction & Audit Trail
features.description: All AI-generated content passes through PII redaction before being surfaced to agents, and every action is logged with a complete audit trail.

title: Inside the LLM — Interactive LLM Inference Visualization
description: An interactive visualization that walks users through the major stages of LLM inference—from tokenization and embeddings through attention, transformer processing, sampling, generation, context windows, and RAG—with real GPT tokenization and honest labeling of simulated vs. real computation.
highlights: 11-stage pipeline covering tokenization, embeddings, positional encoding, attention, transformer layers, prediction, sampling, generation, context windows, and RAG.
D3-powered interactive visualizations including attention heatmaps and embedding scatterplots, with beginner and technical explanation modes.
Runs entirely in the browser with no API calls; provider pattern enables real model backends without UI changes.

details.problemStatement: LLMs are a black box to most people — including the engineers and executives making decisions about them. This tool turns the inference process into something you can see and interact with, stage by stage.
details.extendedDescription:
Inside the LLM is an educational tool designed to demystify how large language models actually work. Instead of treating inference as a black box, it breaks the process into 11 interactive stages that users can explore at their own pace.

Starting with tokenization (using the real GPT tokenizer), users can see how text becomes tokens, how those tokens are embedded into high-dimensional vectors, and how positional encoding gives the model a sense of order. The attention mechanism is visualized with interactive D3 heatmaps that show which tokens attend to which.

The project is honest about what is simulated and what is real computation. It runs entirely in the browser with zero API calls, but the architecture uses a provider pattern that would allow swapping in real model backends without any UI changes. Both beginner and technical explanation modes are available for each stage.

features.title: 11-Stage Inference Pipeline
features.description: From tokenization to RAG, each stage of LLM inference is presented as an interactive, explorable step with visual explanations.

features.title: D3 Interactive Visualizations
features.description: Attention heatmaps and embedding scatterplots built with D3.js let users interactively explore how the model processes information.

features.title: Beginner & Technical Modes
features.description: Every stage offers two explanation levels — beginner-friendly overviews and detailed technical breakdowns — so the tool serves both curious newcomers and ML practitioners.

features.title: Fully Client-Side
features.description: The entire application runs in the browser with no API calls. Real GPT tokenization is performed locally, and the provider pattern allows plugging in real model backends.

title: KoeJLPT — Voice-First JLPT Preparation App
description: A voice-first Japanese Language Proficiency Test preparation app. Level-based vocabulary study, real-time WebRTC AI voice conversations exclusively in Japanese, and automatic pronunciation grading via Google Cloud Speech-to-Text.
highlights: Real-time WebRTC voice conversations with AI partner Fumi — all in Japanese — powered by ElevenLabs.
Three pronunciation practice modes with automatic grading via Google Cloud Speech-to-Text.
Level-based vocabulary study (N5–N1) with audio playback, save functionality, and persistent study streak tracking.

details.problemStatement: Most JLPT prep apps are glorified flashcard decks — KoeJLPT builds real speaking and listening fluency through AI voice conversations and automatic pronunciation grading, closing the gap between study and actual use.
details.extendedDescription:
KoeJLPT takes a voice-first approach to Japanese language study. Most JLPT prep apps focus on reading and multiple choice — KoeJLPT prioritizes speaking and listening, the skills that matter most for real communication.

The centerpiece is Fumi, an AI conversation partner powered by ElevenLabs WebRTC. Fumi speaks exclusively in Japanese at a pace appropriate to the learner's JLPT level, creating an immersive practice environment. Pronunciation is automatically graded using Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, with three distinct practice modes for different skill focuses.

Level-based vocabulary study covers all JLPT levels from N5 (beginner) through N1 (advanced), with native audio playback, save functionality for building personal study lists, and a persistent streak system to encourage daily practice.

features.description: Real-time WebRTC voice conversations with AI partner Fumi, powered by ElevenLabs. Conversations happen exclusively in Japanese at a pace matched to the learner's level.

features.description: Three practice modes with automatic pronunciation scoring via Google Cloud Speech-to-Text. Learners get immediate feedback on accuracy and areas for improvement.

features.description: Complete vocabulary coverage from N5 to N1, with native audio playback, personal save lists, and spaced repetition to reinforce retention.

title: AI Coding Tutor — Interactive AI-Powered Coding Challenge System
description: An intelligent, web-based educational platform that teaches web development fundamentals through hands-on coding challenges. Students write real code in a browser-based Monaco editor, get instant automated feedback, and receive personalized guidance from an AI tutor powered by Claude 3.5.
highlights: 240 progressive coding challenges across HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Full Stack — with 160 enhanced variants featuring three-tier hints and multiple solutions.
AI-powered adaptive tutor (Claude 3.5 Haiku & Sonnet) provides contextual help, explanations, and personalized guidance based on student code.
Monaco Editor (VS Code engine) with live preview, solution locking after 3 attempts, and AI-generated themed challenge variants.

details.problemStatement: Coding bootcamps and online courses teach concepts — but students only improve by writing actual code with immediate, intelligent feedback. This platform gives every learner a personal AI tutor that reads their code and meets them where they're stuck.
details.extendedDescription:
The AI Coding Tutor is built on the belief that the best way to learn programming is by writing real code with intelligent guidance. Students work through 240 progressive challenges spanning HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and full-stack development, writing code directly in a browser-based Monaco editor — the same engine that powers VS Code.

What makes this platform different is the AI tutor powered by Claude 3.5. Rather than just checking answers against a solution key, the AI analyzes the student's actual code to provide contextual help, explanations, and personalized guidance. It adapts to where the student is struggling and offers targeted assistance.

160 of the challenges include enhanced variants with three-tier hints (nudge, guide, and full walkthrough) and multiple valid solutions. After three unsuccessful attempts, the solution is unlocked so students can learn from it and move forward. The AI can also generate themed challenge variants for additional practice.

features.description: Challenges span HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and full-stack development, organized in a progressive difficulty curve that builds skills incrementally.

features.title: Three-Tier Hint System
features.description: Enhanced challenges offer nudge, guide, and full walkthrough hints. Solutions unlock after three attempts to prevent frustration while encouraging genuine effort.

title: The Udemy Course Compress-a-macator 5000
description: A TypeScript/Node.js tool that compresses Udemy courses into AI-generated study plans. Requires an active Udemy login and purchased access to the course being scraped — Playwright uses your existing session to extract transcripts, then Claude ranks each lesson as build / watch / skim / skip and reorders them into an optimal path.
highlights: Playwright drives a persistent Chromium session to extract transcripts from all course lectures.
Claude AI (Haiku + Sonnet) classifies each lesson as build/watch/skim/skip and generates an optimized study plan.
Dual interface: React/Vite web UI at localhost:5173 and a CLI — both backed by an Express API.

details.problemStatement: Online courses are padded — not every lecture is worth your time. This tool reads the whole course for you, classifies each lesson, and hands back an optimized path so you spend time building, not skimming.
details.extendedDescription:
The Udemy Course Compress-a-macator 5000 solves a common problem for online learners: not every lecture in a course is equally valuable. Some lessons are essential hands-on exercises, others are quick overviews, and some can be safely skipped entirely.

The tool uses Playwright to drive a persistent Chromium session (using your existing Udemy login) to extract transcripts from every lecture in a course. These transcripts are then analyzed by Claude AI, which classifies each lesson into one of four categories: build (code along), watch (important concepts), skim (review quickly), or skip (redundant content).

The result is a compressed, reordered study plan that prioritizes the most valuable content. Both a React/Vite web interface and a CLI are available, backed by an Express API server.

features.title: Automated Transcript Extraction
features.description: Playwright drives a persistent Chromium browser session using your existing Udemy credentials to extract transcripts from every lecture in a course.

features.title: AI-Powered Lesson Classification
features.description: Claude AI (Haiku for initial classification, Sonnet for study plan generation) categorizes each lesson as build, watch, skim, or skip based on content analysis.

features.title: Optimized Study Plan
features.description: Lessons are reordered into an optimal learning path that prioritizes hands-on building and essential concepts while deprioritizing redundant content.

features.title: Dual Interface
features.description: Both a React/Vite web UI and a command-line interface are provided, giving users flexibility in how they interact with the tool.
